notes.title: The game is released. But what next?
notes.notes: [p]Hello, everyone! [/p][p][/p][p]We hear your concerns about the fate of the project. So we want to share a little bit about what we're doing right now. We're working on a demo for the Sketch Crawler 2. Here's a videos showing our experiments with real-time gameplay.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41115784/ba1b151522b55f6041a1b279b7dc2a5bae1dce98.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This doesn't mean we're giving up on the first part. We plan to release at least few more updates.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41115784/7daf66671ba9b1b39ce7e71b1a7f98f97794abb4.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The reasons are that the first part did not receive the expected attention, we concluded that the game formula of the first part was not cool enough, and besides, the first part was born in experiments. notes.title: Update v1.01
notes.notes:
Hi friends! The game improvements continue and today we have a new update that improves the game balance and adds a lot of useful fixes. 

[list]
[*] released a free demo of the game for new players.
[*] added peaceful game mode - all creatures are neutral to the player until he attacks them.
[*] Improved game performance, removed freezes every 5 moves.
[*] improved rare cards loot, now the more difficult the location, the more rare cards drop out.
[*] improved creature difficulty balance - what creatures appear and when, how much health they have, what level they are and what cards they have.
[*] improved Morrorwoods map - increased its size, added more buildings to it.
[*] improved the AI of the ally, now he is in a calm state constantly following the player on the heels. He also doesn't get close to traps.
[*] AI fix - if the summoned creatures are in battle, the player cannot rest and cards are not dealt to his hand.
[*] in the generation added special rooms with keys that stand out from the rest of the level.
[*] improved the lighting of the game, now all light sources cast shadows, such as bonfires.
[*] balanced the maximum probability of triggering abilities or defenses, now they have an upper threshold, for example, physical resistance can be no more than 50%.
[*] added a button to change music, by default it is “ENTER”.
[*] added a button for quick switching between allies, by default it is “CTRL”.
[*] fixed a bug where instead of casting attack magic on the enemy, it was cast on the player.
[*] now rest does not waste time and no one will run up to the player during the rest.
[*] fixed the display of cards in the hand, when you can not cast them, if there is not enough mana or silent. 
[*] fixed the generation of doors, now they are not generated in an empty place, only between the walls.
[*] made a lot of small fixes that improve the understanding and usability of the game.
[/list]
Have a nice game!

notes.title: DLC Supporter Pack
notes.notes:
Great news everyone! Now you can support our small team by purchasing the Supporter Pack for Sketch Crawler! Yeah!

[list]
[*] This pack will open the game's internal editor, which we call the Builder. This is where we make the game. During the game, you can switch to it by pressing [T].
[*] You will get access to the console where you can save and load your levels.
[*] You will have access to the library of all the maps in the game.
[/list]

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Yahoo! Sketch Crawler has been RELEASED!!!
notes.notes:
Dear friends, get your pencils and tablets ready, because Sketch Crawler is finally blasting into Steam! Yes, you heard right - it's not an illusion or a double-kek spell, it's a long-awaited release!

After six years, thousands of mugs of puerh and countless battles with bugs, we are ready to present you our creation. We have created a game where doodling is not just drawing, but a portal to the magical world of the magic of the Doodlers, the protagonists of this world. Now your doodles can save the world!

We mixed classic dungeon crawler and card game, and we got a kind of adventure-flavored gaming cocktail.

But that's not the end of our epic quest! We are still working on Sketch Crawler and we are already preparing for you surprises and improvements that will make the game even more exciting. More levels, more magic and a whole wagon full of possibilities.

Welcome aboard our game making band! Thank you for your support - you are the best! We are waiting for your feedback, they are like a health potion after a boss fight.

With love and kitties,
Your a bit crazy Sketch Crawler development team.

notes.title: Update v0.74
notes.notes:
Hi friends! 

We have a new update that fixes issues with drawing tablets, improves game balance and adds useful fixes. 

About monetization - after your comments under the monetization discussion, we decided to remove microtransactions from the game and make the game paid on release with an estimated price of $10. 

This is the last more or less major update before the release. We plan to release it this fall, when we will add a very important feature that the game needs a lot. 

[list]
[*] fixed a bug blocking drawing from a tablet
[*] improved game balance
[*] improved dungeon generation - complex rooms are found later in the game
[*] improved generation of islands - added rewards in buildings, buildings better fit the locations in which they appear
[*] reduced prices in the store
[*] in the descriptions of objects like statues and altars, added display of the effects they have when interacting with them.
[*] added fog on islands and some dungeon levels
[*] added base attack card, which summarizes all the effects of the character affecting the melee damage
[*] now completing the game in easy mode also opens NEW GAME+
[*] simplified the choice of game difficulty - now there are three difficulties EASY, NORM and HARD
[*] added new hints during the game
[*] added the ability to redraw the grass on the islands
[*] and also fixed a number of minor bugs and errors.
[/list]
Have fun playing!

[*] Fixed the new Ghost avatar, now it can be bought in the store.
[*] Also fixed a number of small bugs and bugs.
[/list]
Have fun playing!

notes.title: Discussion about the future of Sketch Crawler and its monetization.
notes.notes:
Greetings, dear Sketch Crawler players!

We invite you to take part in an important discussion about the future of our game and its monetization.

Sketch Crawler is moving towards release, but we have not yet decided how the game will pay for further development. The game has been 5 years in the making, and all this time we've been funding it with our own money, which honestly hasn't been easy.

Initially we looked at a Free to Play (F2P) model with microtransactions, similar to Hearthstone, where you could buy sealed decks, avatars, and other items for real money. However, this often drew negative reactions and as a result negative reviews. As time passed, we realized that such a model negatively affects the feel of the game in a way that feels like it's tricking players into paying money. The difficulty of the game is no longer perceived as an interesting challenge, but rather as a torment designed to send the player to the store to buy boosts. 

That's why we made the decision to disable microtransactions in order to look at other options and find a better and fair way. 

Right now we are thinking of choosing the option of a one-time purchase of the game for $10 on release, and selling big DLC with new content - locations, avatars, maps and abilities.

So it's important for us to hear what you think before we make a final decision. Share your thoughts. What price do you think is fair? Or maybe you have other monetization suggestions that better suit the game?

Regardless of the final decision, the game will remain free until release.

Thank you for your participation and support!

notes.title: Huge update v0.7
notes.notes:
Hello, friends! We have prepared a new huge update for you! We've added new adventure areas in the form of procedurally generated islands surrounded by water, filled with constructions, deadly creatures, challenges, and dangerous adventures. Besides, the update has a lot of new features, balance and AI improvements. 

[list]
[*] Improved enemy AI, taught them new tricks, now they act smarter and are harder to fool. 
[*] Improved card descriptions, making them easier to understand.
[*] Improved the balance of the game and card effects.
[*] Added a color saturation slider to the Drawing Editor.
[*] In the Drawing Editor added a hot key to move the camera - X.
[*] In the Drawing Editor added frame transfer between different cards. Signature of authorship is saved during such transfer. 
[*] In the Drawing Editor when we play an animation, it plays its sounds. It is convenient to understand whether its sound is suitable. 
[*] Added new endings of the game, designed for passing in New Game+ modes. 
[*] New Game+ modes are different in difficulty, bosses and game endings with unexpected twists and turns. 
[*] Improved necromancy cards for raising the dead. The dead now gain a random level from level one to necromancer level. 
[*] Added a variety of magic effects that apply when interacting with statues, magical objects, altars, and fountains.
[*] Improved the level map, now it can be moved (mouse and keyboard) and zoomed (mouse wheel).
[*] Now the level of generated traps changes and corresponds to the difficulty of the location.
[*] When an ability or trigger on a creature is activated, it makes a sound. 
[*] Reduced the number of prototype cards falling out of the prototype deck. Now there will be 3 instead of 5.
[*] Added an Enable or Disable All button to the skins.
[*] Made equipment in slots play animation.
[*] Made settings for the range of rendering objects in the game, useful for those who have low fps in game.
[*] Added a lot of new quests.
[*] Added a change in the size of creatures depending on their level.
[*] In hard mod now cards are not removed from the collection when starting a new game, instead they are sent to the graveyard.
[*] If kicking a lying creature, it now flies away from the kick an unlimited number of times. Helps make it easier to run away if you have somewhere to fly off to.
[*] And also made a huge number of small improvements and fixes. 
[/list]
In the near future, we plan to improve the generation of islands, megamagic and the creation of your own cards, a level editor, and adding story quests and new mysteries. 

Enjoy the game! 

Write us your impressions of the update. You support us greatly and help us understand what works for you in the game and what doesn't.

notes.title: Happy New Year, friends!
notes.notes:
Yoo-hoo! Our experimental project continues to actively evolve.

This year the game has a lot of things - card upgrades, new game+, hardcore mode, horror elements, new card mechanics, new quests and creatures, card graveyard, new collection interface, greatly improved gameplay and balance, the game has become simpler and user-friendly, got skins and steam workshop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41115784/9e67027de022fe4fb2768f4312b0f1768e85481f.jpg[/img]
And for next year we have even more ambitious plans - we want to take the game to the next level by adding open world generation of islands and continents with mountains, forests, castles, settlements and dungeons. All of this will be generated along with the story and quests.  We are actively experimenting with this now and preparing a big update. Plans include a new story, quests, card mechanics, editor and world generator. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41115784/e47dd94e649062f8ca8ba70b7a5d1b8c85d8df96.jpg[/img]
We are very happy that you like our game and we will try to do our best next year to surprise you more than once. 

Tell us how this year went for you and what you think about our progress! 

Good luck and have a great game in the new year!

notes.title: Update v0.67
notes.notes:
Hi friends, we have prepared another update for you! We added a new game mode, improved game intro, made a lot of gameplay improvements. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41115784/75a81259bf9fa59e264df48b8fd30ec11173957a.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Hardcore mod - a new game mode, available from the start. In hardcore all cards from the collection are lost on the death of your character, but the experience is doubled. 
[*] Loot has become more powerful - now cards you pick up can be already leveled up.
[*] The duration of effects from elixirs, global spells and resists has changed. Now they last until the character rests.
[*] Made a lot of game balance fixes - high level creatures became more powerful. Magic has gotten stronger. 
[*] Improved redraw quests. Now they are not given for all level objects of the same type, but for a specific object. The quest can be done later on another level. Added cards with descriptions of the quest in the quests section. 
[*] Added a story intro about the King of Cartoons at the start of the game.
[*] Redesigned the store - greatly simplified all the goods, removed crystals. Now all goods can be bought for gold, which is obtained in the game. Removed monetization, crystal and gold mines. 
[*] Changed the breaking of equipment and weapons. Now they do not go to the graveyard, they can only be repaired at the anvil. 
[*] Now you can't escape by ally to another level while the player is in danger.
[*] Fountains now apply different boosts depending on the color of the fountain.
[*] The collection now shows all the upgrades of the selected card. 
[*] A lot of fixes have been made to card fusing. 
[*] Made fixes for bad level generation, when the generation gets rooms that can't be accessed. 
[*] Added a visual hint in the form of cells on the floor. To make it easier to navigate on the level. The hint can be disabled in the settings.
[*] Fixed a lot of small bugs and buggy moments.
[/list]
Enjoy the game!

Have fun playing! Write us more, it supports us a lot!

notes.title: Update v0.53
notes.notes:
Discord. image import, New game+, new balance, improved card descriptions, tons of fixes and more. 

Hello, friends! Following the recent update, we've added even more great new features for our beloved game. Here they are!

[b]What's new?[/b]
[list]
[*] Import. Now you can add your own images to the game. To do this, you need them to be PNG and the desired resolution is 256x256. Added to the drawing editor. 
[*] New game+ Now, after completing the game, you will open a more difficult game mode with more dangerous opponents. And after completing New game+, you will open New game++. What will happen if you pass it too? You'll see if you do :)
[*] Improved effect descriptions on cards to make them easier to understand
[*] Sketch Crawler discord server. Yay! Add from the main menu.
[*] The higher the level of the creature, the more experience it will give you. 10% per level. 
[*] New items in the store - Gold and Crystal Mines, as well as the Portal to the treasures of Multiland.
[*] Color resists have been changed, now they will give magic resist instead of color resist.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Ai creatures to jump into their traps
[*] Disenchant can now remove creature effects.
[*] Introduced a limit on the number of additional effects on creatures. Now there are a maximum of three effects, plus one additional effect for the creature's pure color.
[*] Fixed a bug when creatures ran with 0 health.
[*] And many more small fixes. 
[/list]
PS: we're very excited to see how the image import feature will work. For us, this is a new era in Sketch Crawler creativity. 

Enjoy the game, friends! And see you soon!

notes.title: Woo-hoo! Major update v0.5
notes.notes:
Hi friends, we're finally here! 

We've done a lot of work! The game is becoming more and more what we want it to be. There are many more updates ahead, but for us this one is special. After redesigning the interface, introducing a lab and a graveyard, the game is up and running on a new level. Game balance has become friendlier, and the interface and tooltips are clearer. 

What's new?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41115784/e88477329520a8328901a45659f400cf2b76b36a.png[/img]
[b]Added Laboratory and card progression[/b]
[list]
[*] In the magic lab you can level up your cards, as long as you have enough essence. 
[*] Color plays an important role in card progression. When a card gets a level it gives you a choice of card upgrades, depending on the color of the card.
[*] There is an additional ability for pure color - when only one color is used on the card. Opens at the third level. 
[*] Card progression also affected the creatures that the player meets in the dungeons. Their ability and effects depend on their color.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41115784/54949124af10c8391a7383d1d6a30e1e66f21665.png[/img]
[b]Added Graveyard.[/b]
Now your cards don't disappear when you die, but go to the graveyard. Here they can be returned or sold for essence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41115784/65aab40a80e2bbe5a82c4d7ffef2295452fe31f9.png[/img]
[b]Added Shop[/b]
Here you can buy different card sets, unlock game abilities, buy essence, gold and crystals. We added a new items to the shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41115784/f1c0205e29403c63ed6cab4b6446a54aad7d3a18.png[/img]
[b]Also: [/b]
[list]
[*] Improved game balance, the game has become friendlier for newcomers, but is still a challenge for experienced players. 
[*] Added about 100 new creatures.
[*] Redesigned game locations, added new rooms, puzzles, traps and buildings.
[*] Added an option to reset your save.
[*] When you publish a skin, you can immediately check the box "make a skin public" and your skin will immediately become available in the studio.
[*] Reworked collection interface, now all the features are easily accessible by pressing TAB button.
[/list]

[b]Lots of fixes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixes for better usability and understandability of the game.
[*] Reworked and improved tutorial tips.
[*] On the illusion walls, the same valdecors on both sides.
[*] AIs do not jump into their traps.
[*] Card descriptions are now saved and uploaded to the image archive. 
[*] Prototype cards are now available to all avatars.
[*] Fixed the animations of creatures when they use magic.
[*] Fireballs now don't collide when flying towards them.
[*] Fear is applied to enemies only if the character has less than 100% health.
[*] Fixed the sticking of blocks like Arch, now it is normally sticking to the neighboring blocks.
[*] When the key is applied, it is displayed on the obstacle.
[*] If an ally is selected to stand still, then when playing an ally the player's character stands still.
[*] Shows the number of new cards in Quests, Lab, Collection, Create, and Graveyard.
[*] Removed pushing stalking creatures from another level.
[*] Tutorial level no longer has its own location and you can not get into it, after the passage of the tutorial.
[*] Antimagic and reflexes now only repel hostile magic.
[*] And many other minor fixes.
[/list]

Thank you for being with us and believing in us! When we read your reviews, about how you like the game, we understand that we're working for a reason! Have a great game!

notes.title: What's next?
notes.notes:
Hello friends, we are currently working on a major update that will bring something new to the game. 

We're adding endless upgrade to all magic cards, traps, creatures, etc. Now they can be upgraded by adding new attributes, and the color of the card will greatly affect the possible effects of the card. Also will be added a lot of new abilities for leveling up the cards. Upgrade will also affect the enemies with their magic, which will make the game even more interesting. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41115784/e968f90bff287b4d9e422f1a5201ebc0dcbb4c66.png[/img]

Also, we are working on the interface to make it even more convenient and understandable. 

[b]Next in our plans:[/b]
[list]
[*] More quests and story in the game. 
[*] A level editor.
[*] Advanced level generation.
[*] New gameplay mechanics for cards.
[*] New game+
[/list]
Please tell us what you'd like to see in the next updates? What do you want to see in the game?

notes.title: Update v0.42
notes.notes:
Hello friends! Work on the game continues and we have a fresh update for you. 

[b]CHANGES AND FIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Archive will now save who the original author of the card. After you save you have to hover your mouse cursor over the image in the Archive and it will say who the original author and the history of changes by other players.
[*] The text descriptions and voice acting of the cards is also saved in the Archive.

notes.title: What we try to achieve in Sketch Crawler?
notes.notes:
Is it possible to mix drawing and gaming? Can comedic fantasy and user-generated content be mixed? Can there be a benefit to a computer game? Let's explore. 

Sketch Crowler is a experimental game and we plan to experiment well with procedural generation, comedic cartoon fantasy and user-generated content. We think it can be fun. 

Experimentation will keep coming. We're looking for a golden formula for a game that will come together into something friendly and holistic that will be a joy to play for years to come. 

We don't know where it will take us. We believe that only by exploring the unmapped paths can we discover something new. Ideally, it's not demanding to hardware game, which will live, even without internet, just on the user's computer. 

A little about the graphics of the game. The simplicity of the style of drawing in Sketch Crawler is our conscious choice. First, it is much more expressive and charismatic than realistic characters, secondly, it is much easier for players to add their own drawings in this world, they look more holistic, in a third, it is a meme graphics, and this supports the comedy of what is happening.

We chose a form of free play model with in-game purchases to give everyone a touch of the project and ensure its longevity. We are also looking for a good form of monetization. We know the difference between dark and light monetization and we are definitely on the light side. We think there should be a fair exchange between players and developers. 

In our opinion, the phenomenon of beneficial games is an obvious fact. These games are games that develop the player and give him practical benefits in life. The game is not an escape from reality, but a way to discover abilities and take them into the real world. This is the kind of game we see in Sketch Crawler.

In Sketch Crawler the player practices his drawing skill. The game constantly tempts to draw. And the longer the player plays, the better he will draw. And it also develops his imagination. 

Creativity will save the world, and Sketch Crawler will help with that!

Tell us what you think about such approach?

notes.title: Sketch Crawler comes out in Early Access on November 15!
notes.notes:
Yay, we're releasing Early Access! After a long 4 years of development and experimentation the game became something solid and playable, which we are happy to share with you. Sketch Crawler has evolved significantly, compared to the demo it added a lot of new mechanics, cards, locations, creatures and so on.

What awaits you in the early access?

The game is fully playable to the very end. It uses procedural level generation, has 4 main locations, 300+ characters and 300+ magic cards. There are also options to draw any card or item in the game, and even re-sound the characters.

What's next

Although the game is already passable, it's still not complete. We will continue to develop the game by adding new card mechanics, locations, quests, and characters. We also plan to add a user-generated content sharing system.

Please write us, what do you think about Sketch Crawler? How would you like to see it? What should we focus our attention on?

Thanks for playing!

Welcome, traveler!

The long-awaited moment has finally arrived - Sketch Crawler's demo is released.

This is the result of three years of research conducted by a humble indie team - the very first public demo. It's still raw, but it's already fun to play.

Welcome, traveler! 

Today is a very special day for our little team. We've been preparing for this moment for several years. Experimented. In a creative search, we rushed from hope to despair and back again. Until we found the sparkles of which we gathered what we want to share with you. 

Sketch Crawler is a very wild and experimental indie project. So wild that we don't even count on publishers. We plan to self-publish and keep the spirit and independence of the project throughout its life. We are not only independent from investors and publishers, we generally act in the spirit of the developers driven by the dream to create something meaningful.

The team is headed by a veteran game designer and screenwriter who has many projects under his belt with more than 20 years of experience. This project has been maturing for a long time and I'm glad it's finally coming out.

Happy to meet you and hear your impressions of our page and of course your wishes from the game. 

Add the game to your Wishlists and help promote Sketch Crawler. And in September we'll release the demo and then the real fun begins. 

With gratitude, 
Koan
